mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of absolute rate level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.2% monthly) signal overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting both growth thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% sustained for 3 months), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity suppress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) over the prior three months signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with rising HOUST, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 indicates economic contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Demand growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% quarterly) combined with supply contraction (INDPRO < -0.3% monthly) creates supply-demand imbalance driving inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting both growth thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.3%), sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence generate positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
